parts.name: AlertDialogRoot
parts.description: Holds the alert dialog's open state. It is a DialogRoot that is always modal, has `role="alertdialog"` and ignores a press outside.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the alert dialog is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the alert dialog is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a part or Escape asks to open or close the alert dialog. A controlled alert dialog changes only when `open` does. It is called in a change of its own, after the alert dialog's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold it.

parts.name: AlertDialogTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens the alert dialog. Optional when the dialog is controlled.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual emphasis of the action, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and padding of the button, on the same scale as Button.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the alert dialog is open.

parts.name: AlertDialogPopup
parts.description: The `<dialog>` element, with `role="alertdialog"`. Style it with `[open]`, `::backdrop`, `@starting-style` and `[data-ending-style]`.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the alert dialog animates out. It stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

parts.name: AlertDialogTitle
parts.description: A heading that names the alert dialog. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: AlertDialogDescription
parts.description: A paragraph that describes the alert dialog. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

parts.name: AlertDialogClose
parts.description: A button that closes the alert dialog, after running its own `onClick`. Use one for each answer.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual emphasis of the action, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and padding of the button, on the same scale as Button.

parts.name: AlertDialogFooter
parts.description: A Glaze layout part: the row of actions that ends the popup. Put the primary action last.
